features.description: The ty CI jobs are separate jobs that leave the existing test job's steps intact, and the repo-wide job really checks the whole repo.
features.verify:
.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import yaml,subprocess
new=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/test.yml'))['jobs']
old=yaml.safe_load(subprocess.run(['git','show','42486f9:.github/workflows/test.yml'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)['jobs']
for name,job in old.items():
    assert [s.get('name') for s in job.get('steps',[])]==[s.get('name') for s in new[name].get('steps',[])], name
assert 'ty' in new and 'ty-repo-wide' in new
print('ok')
EOF
steps: Move the ty and ty-repo-wide jobs so no existing job loses steps (data source: the workflow at 42486f9, compared job by job in the verify command).
ty-repo-wide checks the whole repo: pass explicit paths (e.g. `uvx ty@0.0.96 check src tests`) so it does not inherit [tool.ty.src] include; keep continue-on-error: true.
Mutation: move one step of an existing job into ty-repo-wide -> verify fails -> revert.
